annotations.title: SEO audit, on-page: title, meta, headings, links and issues

description: On-page SEO audit of one URL: title and meta description with their lengths, canonical, meta robots, H1s and H2 count, images without alt text, lang and viewport, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, JSON-LD blocks, internal and external link counts and word count, plus a list of issues and a 0-100 score. Reads the server's HTML (no JavaScript), up to 1 MB. Use to check a page before publishing or to compare competitors. Example: url=https://www.wikipedia.org/. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
